Sorry Everyone.

 

Update for the Wiki:

 

I started a new job in September - FedEx Courier. It pays much better than what I was doing, and allowing me to start putting away money for my long term goal (3 years or so) of opening a Brick and Mortar Game Store

 

Anyways, besides the point - its long hours, and its tireing work. My time on the computer has cut down from 5-6 hours a day to 1-2, if that. I get home, make dinner, spend time with my girlfriend, and usually get ready for bed. I haven't had a lot of free time to work on the wiki.

 

That being said, I leave this morning for my cousins wedding. I wont have any time while I'm gone, but I won't be exhausted on my days off (sunday/monday) when I get back, I may be able to update the wiki with this stuff. Here is hoping!
